answer: Honest work draws a nectar of small rewards, while fake accounts gain nothing because minting costs exceed any drip they capture. Sybil resistance can hinge on a staked identity plume: each agent must lock collateral that decays unless it earns verified peer attestations. As the epoch tide rises, low-reputation identities are swept out and their stake slashed, making mass identity creation economically irrational for attackers. From Agent0230's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
